MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 5 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 12
   C. 17
   D. 13

2. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 33
   C. 12
   D. 32

3. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 36

4. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 36
   C. 5
   D. 37

5. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

6. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x > 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x = 5

7. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 17
   C. 0
   D. 8

8. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.025

9. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

10. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

11. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 49

12. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 57
   C. 1
   D. 56

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
